name: Android Documentation
description: Authoring and maintaining a managed project's documentation, decision records, and release notes: binding every document to the revision it describes, recording a decision with its alternatives, consequences, and reversal condition, keeping status claims inside the real status vocabulary, and citing evidence rather than asserting it. The handbook and artifact release report are generated by ProjectHandbookService and ReleaseReportService, which this skill never overrides (BS §79.7; TA §53.9).
